description: Template for your own questions. Copy this file (e.g. to my_questions.json), edit the entries, then run with: python3 benchmark.py run --questions built-in my_questions.json ... See README.md 'Adding your own questions' for the grading-type decision guide.

questions.prompt: How many days are in a leap year? Respond with only the number.
What HTTP status code means 'Not Found'? Respond with only the number.
Is the number 17 prime? Respond with only TRUE or FALSE.
Respond with valid JSON only (no other text): an object with key "status" set to "ok".
In two or three sentences, what should someone do if the deploy pipeline fails? (Replace this with a real question about your own domain/docs.)
